platforms.name: GitHub Actions
platforms.free_tier_notes: Unlimited minutes for public repos; 2000 min/month free for private repos (Linux). Pay-as-you-go beyond.
platforms.secret_management: GitHub Secrets (encrypted at rest), organization and environment secrets
platforms.best_for: GitHub-hosted open-source and private projects; rich ecosystem of pre-built actions
platforms.limitations: Vendor lock-in to GitHub; runners are ephemeral and have limited customization outside self-hosted
platforms.pricing_summary: Free for public repos; metered per-minute for private repos beyond free tier

platforms.name: GitLab CI/CD
platforms.free_tier_notes: 400 CI/CD compute minutes/month on shared runners for free tier; unlimited on self-hosted
platforms.secret_management: GitLab CI/CD Variables (masked, protected, file-type) and HashiCorp Vault integration
platforms.marketplace: GitLab CI/CD Catalog and shared components
platforms.best_for: Self-hosted private infrastructure; integrated DevSecOps platform with built-in security scanning
platforms.limitations: Steeper learning curve than GitHub Actions; self-managed runners require maintenance overhead
platforms.pricing_summary: Free tier with 400 min/month on SaaS; Premium and Ultimate tiers unlock more compute and features

platforms.name: CircleCI
platforms.free_tier_notes: 6,000 build minutes/month for open-source projects; 30,000 user-seconds on free tier for private
platforms.secret_management: CircleCI Contexts and environment variables with restricted access
platforms.best_for: High-performance Docker-based pipelines; large test suites that benefit from parallelism
platforms.limitations: Pricing per-user has increased friction for large teams; orbs add an abstraction layer
platforms.pricing_summary: Free for open source; performance and scale plans for private repos with usage-based billing

platforms.name: Jenkins
platforms.free_tier_notes: Fully self-hosted and free; no managed minutes — you run your own controller and agents
platforms.secret_management: Credentials plugin, HashiCorp Vault plugin, and native Credentials store
platforms.best_for: Highly customized enterprise pipelines; on-prem environments with full control requirements
platforms.limitations: Operational overhead for self-managed controllers; plugin compatibility issues across upgrades
platforms.pricing_summary: Free, self-hosted (compute and ops costs apply); Jenkins X (managed) via CloudBees commercial tier

platforms.name: Drone CI
platforms.free_tier_notes: Open-source runners are self-hosted and free; Drone Cloud offers managed tiers with monthly build credits
platforms.secret_management: Drone Secrets (encrypted at rest) and integration with external vaults
platforms.best_for: Container-native pipelines; lightweight, single-binary self-hosted CI for Docker-first teams
platforms.limitations: Smaller community and ecosystem than GitHub Actions or Jenkins; fewer out-of-the-box integrations
platforms.pricing_summary: Free, open source (self-hosted); Drone Cloud paid tiers for hosted runners and enterprise features
